SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE.
（批：cep）
REPORT
S.2, Special Branch.
Date March 16, 1934.
（印：File No. SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE C. & S. B. REGISTRY. No. D 3731 Date 17/3/34）
Subject (full) Communist suspect named Lau Lee (老李).
Made by and Forwarded by D.I. Ross.
With reference to the attached report on the
subject of a communist suspect named Lau Lee (老李), reported
to be a member of the local Red Labour Union, I have to state
that this individual was not observed by agents of the
Shanghai Public Safety Bureau on Nanking Road during the
afternoon of March 11, 1934.
（签名）
D. I.
（批：file 3/2）
Deputy Commissioner,
Special Branch.

事由（全称）：名为老李（Lau Lee）的共产党嫌疑犯。
撰写及呈报人：副督察长罗斯（Ross）。
关于所附有关名为老李（Lau Lee）的共产党嫌疑犯的报告，据称其为本地赤色工会成员，本人须声明，上海公安局特工人员于1934年3月11日下午在南京路并未发现此人。

SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE.
Section 2, Special Branch.
REPORT

(印章：SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE / File No. / S. B. REGISTRY. / 5731)
Date Mar Date 11, 1/3/34 32

Subject (in full) Telephone message from Pang Kung Chih to D.I. Kuh Pao Hwa
re communist suspect named Lau Lee (老李).

Made by .................... and ........................................ Forwarded by D.I. Ross

At 11 a.m. March 11, 1934, D.I. Kuh Pao Hwa reported through
Clerk Zung Zoong Oen having received the following telephone
message from Mr. Pang Kung Chih, Nanking Political Agent at
Shanghai, at 10.50 a.m. March 11:-
" Information has been received that one Lau Lee (老李),
" a member of the local Red Labour Union, will visit Nanking
" Road at about 2 p.m. to-day (11.3.34). Being unable to
" obtain a warrant on Sunday, agents of the Shanghai Public
" Safety Bureau will effect his arrest on Nanking Road with
" the assistance of C.P.C.s on duty. "

(签名：D.B. Ross)
D. I.

Deputy Commissioner,
Special Branch.

(手写批注：Chief Insp. Walker (-) informed.
D.S. Sansom, reports that his
Services were not required.)

(手写批注：S2
Good. Mr Pang taking
would seem to be taking
a little more notice of our
grumbling. Further report
if & when arrest is made
JR)

上海公共租界工部局警务处。
特务科第二股。
报告

(印章：上海公共租界工部局警务处 / 档案号 / 特务科登记处 / 5731)
日期 3月11日 34年1月3日 32

事由（全称）：庞公直致电副督察长顾宝华，事关名为老李（Lau Lee）的共产党嫌疑犯。

撰写人 .................... 及 ........................................ 呈报人：副督察长罗斯

1934年3月11日上午11时，副督察长顾宝华通过办事员钟宗恩（Zung Zoong Oen）报告称，于3月11日上午10时50分收到南京政府驻沪政治特派员庞公直先生的如下电话留言：-
“接获情报，本地赤色工会成员老李（Lau Lee），
“将于今日（34年3月11日）下午2时许前往南京
“路。因周日无法取得逮捕令，上海公安局之特工
“将在当值中央巡捕（C.P.C.s）的协助下，在南京路
“将其逮捕。”

(签名：D.B. Ross)
副督察长

特务科副科长。

(手写批注：已告知总督察沃克（Walker）(-)。
副督察长桑森（Sansom）报告称，
其部门无需介入。)

(手写批注：特二科
好。庞先生似乎
开始稍微重视我们的
不满了。若实施逮捕，
届时再报
JR)
